<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 390 844">
  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="844" fill="#000000"/>

  <!-- Status bar -->
  <g>
    <text x="24" y="26" font-family="SF Pro, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="20" font-weight="700" fill="#FFFFFF">9:41</text>
    <line x1="295" y1="19" x2="300" y2="19" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="295" y1="23" x2="302" y2="23" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="295" y1="27" x2="304" y2="27" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="295" y1="31" x2="306" y2="31" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2"/>
    <circle cx="319" cy="25" r="5" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.8"/>
    <line x1="315" y1="29" x2="312" y2="32" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.8"/>
    <rect x="338" y="18" width="27" height="14" rx="3" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <rect x="340" y="20" width="21" height="10" rx="2" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <rect x="366" y="22" width="2" height="6" rx="1" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Top segmented navigation -->
  <g>
    <rect x="20" y="53" width="350" height="43" rx="22" fill="#24262B"/>
    <rect x="23" y="56" width="188" height="37" rx="19" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <text x="117" y="80" text-anchor="middle" font-family="SF Pro, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="600" fill="#000000">My Friends</text>
    <text x="293" y="80" text-anchor="middle" font-family="SF Pro, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="600" fill="#FFFFFF">Discovery</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Empty state illustration -->
  <g>
    <circle cx="195" cy="306" r="74" fill="#24262B"/>
    <circle cx="195" cy="306" r="58" fill="#3F3F3F" opacity="0.72"/>
    <circle cx="167" cy="291" r="19" fill="#D6D9DD"/>
    <circle cx="222" cy="291" r="19" fill="#A2A2A3"/>
    <ellipse cx="167" cy="329" rx="31" ry="17" fill="#D6D9DD"/>
    <ellipse cx="222" cy="329" rx="31" ry="17" fill="#A2A2A3"/>
    <circle cx="167" cy="291" r="7" fill="#646464"/>
    <circle cx="222" cy="291" r="7" fill="#646464"/>
    <line x1="195" y1="279" x2="195" y2="338" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <circle cx="195" cy="270" r="5" fill="#FF9500"/>
    <line x1="195" y1="260" x2="195" y2="251" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <line x1="185" y1="264" x2="180" y2="257" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <line x1="205" y1="264" x2="210" y2="257" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  </g>

  <g>
    <text x="195" y="421" text-anchor="middle" font-family="SF Pro, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="20" font-weight="600" fill="#FFFFFF">No posts from your friends yet</text>
    <text x="195" y="451" text-anchor="middle" font-family="SF Pro, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="400" fill="#A2A2A3">Be the first to share your day</text>
    <text x="195" y="474" text-anchor="middle" font-family="SF Pro, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="400" fill="#A2A2A3">and start the conversation.</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Primary action -->
  <g>
    <rect x="91" y="501" width="208" height="52" rx="26" fill="#000000" opacity="0.5"/>
    <rect x="91" y="498" width="208" height="52" rx="26" fill="#FAFAFA"/>
    <circle cx="120" cy="524" r="9" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2"/>
    <circle cx="120" cy="524" r="3" fill="#000000"/>
    <line x1="127" y1="531" x2="133" y2="537" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <text x="201" y="530" text-anchor="middle" font-family="SF Pro, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="13" font-weight="600" fill="#000000">Take your BeReal</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Quiet supporting prompt -->
  <g>
    <line x1="42" y1="619" x2="348" y2="619" stroke="#FFFFFF33" stroke-width="1"/>
    <circle cx="66" cy="657" r="15" fill="#39393B"/>
    <circle cx="66" cy="652" r="5" fill="#A2A2A3"/>
    <ellipse cx="66" cy="665" rx="9" ry="5" fill="#A2A2A3"/>
    <text x="94" y="654" font-family="SF Pro, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="13" font-weight="600" fill="#FFFFFF">Invite friends to BeReal</text>
    <text x="94" y="674" font-family="SF Pro, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="400" fill="#A2A2A3">Your feed will appear here when they post.</text>
    <polyline points="337,654 343,660 337,666" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF99" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Bottom navigation -->
  <g>
    <rect x="0" y="733" width="390" height="111" fill="#000000"/>
    <line x1="18" y1="733" x2="372" y2="733" stroke="#FFFFFF33" stroke-width="1"/>

    <!-- Friends -->
    <g>
      <circle cx="48" cy="766" r="20" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
      <circle cx="43" cy="762" r="5" fill="#000000"/>
      <circle cx="54" cy="764" r="4" fill="#000000"/>
      <ellipse cx="43" cy="773" rx="9" ry="5" fill="#000000"/>
      <ellipse cx="55" cy="774" rx="7" ry="4" fill="#000000"/>
      <text x="48" y="805" text-anchor="middle" font-family="SF Pro, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="600" fill="#FFFFFF">Friends</text>
    </g>

    <!-- Discovery -->
    <g>
      <circle cx="146" cy="766" r="19" fill="#FFFFFF33" stroke="#FFFFFF99" stroke-width="1"/>
      <circle cx="143" cy="763" r="6" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2"/>
      <line x1="148" y1="768" x2="154" y2="774" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
      <text x="146" y="805" text-anchor="middle" font-family="SF Pro, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="600" fill="#A2A2A3">Discovery</text>
    </g>

    <!-- Camera -->
    <g>
      <circle cx="244" cy="766" r="20" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
      <rect x="232" y="758" width="24" height="16" rx="4" fill="#000000"/>
      <circle cx="244" cy="766" r="5" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2"/>
      <rect x="237" y="755" width="8" height="4" rx="2" fill="#000000"/>
      <text x="244" y="805" text-anchor="middle" font-family="SF Pro, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="600" fill="#A2A2A3">Camera</text>
    </g>

    <!-- Profile -->
    <g>
      <circle cx="342" cy="766" r="19" fill="#FFFFFF33" stroke="#FFFFFF99" stroke-width="1"/>
      <circle cx="342" cy="761" r="6" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2"/>
      <ellipse cx="342" cy="773" rx="9" ry="5" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2"/>
      <text x="342" y="805" text-anchor="middle" font-family="SF Pro, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="600" fill="#A2A2A3">Profile</text>
    </g>

    <rect x="128" y="829" width="133" height="6" rx="3" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  </g>
</svg>
